title: Archetypes Configuration
description: Schema for archetypes.yaml — named agent archetype definitions with model preference, system prompt, and optional complexity escalation rules. Mirrors the runtime ARCHETYPES_SCHEMA in agent-coordinator/src/agents_config.py (the source of truth); keep the two in sync.

schema_version.description: Schema version. v1 = legacy; v2 enables phase_mapping; v3 adds model_aliases / tier models.

model_aliases.description: Optional map of alias name to a {premium, standard, economy} tier→model mapping (schema_version 3).

archetypes.description: Map of archetype name to archetype configuration.

propertyNames.description: Archetype names must be lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens/underscores, max 32 chars.

model.description: Primary model for this archetype — a tier (premium/standard/economy) or a legacy model name.

system_prompt.description: Role-specific instruction prefix composed with task prompts.

write_capable.description: Whether this archetype may write files/artifacts. Required on every archetype (no implicit default). Write-capable autopilot phases must resolve to an archetype with write_capable: true.

escalate_to.description: Model/tier to escalate to when complexity thresholds are exceeded.

max_write_dirs.description: Escalate when write_allow spans more than this many directory prefixes.

max_dependencies.description: Escalate when package has more than this many cross-module dependencies.

loc_threshold.description: Escalate when package loc_estimate exceeds this threshold.

phase_mapping.description: Optional per-phase archetype resolution (schema_version 2+). Maps a non-terminal autopilot phase to an archetype (+ optional signals).
